steps.say: Some ideas happen in order. | First, price breaks out on heavy volume. | Then, within a few days, the volume dries up.
Add the Recent structure break Group, and the relative volume signal.
Then add a THEN box. | It has a First part, a Then part with a number of days, and an optional Cancel.
First: an upward break, | on at least one and a half times the usual volume.
Then, within five daily closes: volume is back below one and a half times usual.
The editor writes it out in plain words. | First and Then on the same day don't count: Then has to come later.
Save it, and run it on your coins at a past moment.
Yes means both steps happened, in order. | A No with a skip mark is part-way: the breakout happened, and the drop can still come in time.
To see whether anything usually followed, | open the Set and tap Study this Set.
